verdict.rationale: LegalZoom's annual-report page documents a paid service that prepares and files a personalized annual report, starting at $99 plus state fees. It also offers auto-filing of annual reports, optional expedited filing, white-glove compliance management by a dedicated business manager, and free correction of rejected filings caused by LegalZoom's error. The registered-agent service adds deadline reminders. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the annual-report filing service, and an explanation of the conditions behind the † footnote on auto-filing.
